messages:
Sam: Anyone up for a quick 'Clutch Corner Kickers' playoff pick'em? 10 slots, winner buys donuts. Suggestions for scoring? :donut:
Priya: I'm in. Can we do 12-man? donuts tax :D
Luca: Count me in. Thoughts on bonus points for OT wins?
Jordan: In if it's low-effort. Could we just pick winners + 2 tiebreaker points (total goals)?
Anika: Love donuts. +1 for tiebreaker. Also timezone heads-up: kickoff at `2026-05-02T20:00Z` for East coast.
Sam: OK plan: 10 slots, pick winners each game, tie-breaker = total goals. @reminder-bot can you post sign-up poll?
reminder-bot: Quick poll: react with :one: to join, :two: for maybe, :x: to pass. I'll DM registrants 12h before kickoff.
Priya: :one:
Luca: :one:
Jordan: :two:
Anika: :one:
Sam: Also, fantasy commissioner duties: I can run the bracket and spreadsheet unless someone volunteers.
Luca: I can help with the spreadsheet if needed. share template?
Sam: I'll drop a Google sheet link in ~10. Winner gets a classic box of assorted donuts (office pickup).
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Priya: Can we have a consolation prize for best wrong pick? :sweat_smile:
Anika: Haha sure, loser brings coffee for a week.
Sam: Perfect. I'll set reminders and post the sheet. Anyone not in by `2401234578` (12h before) gets bench.
